title: Moving Day
text: {friend} is moving flats. {Friend.he} said “it's only a few boxes”. It's a piano, a canoe and a very angry cat.

ok.text: You carry the piano up five floors. Your back files a complaint. {friend} will never forget it.

effects.remember: Spent a whole day carrying {friend}'s piano.

fail.text: You carry the canoe and the cat. {friend} carries the piano with a stranger. It works out.

lazy.text: You carry one lamp, very slowly, and then supervise from the sofa. The sofa is still in the van.

ok.text: The pizza arrives. The cat eats it. {friend} appreciates the thought.

effects.remember: Sent pizza instead of helping {friend} move.

ok.text: {friend} believes you and sends soup. You feel terrible about the soup.

fail.text: {friend} sees your beach photo online. {Friend.he} moves alone. The cat scratches {friend.him}.

effects.remember: Faked being sick to skip {friend}'s move. Got caught.

choices.label: Rig a pulley and lift the piano through the window

ok.text: It works. The piano flies. A crowd gathers. Someone films it. You're the hero of Elm Street.

effects.remember: Flew {friend}'s piano through a window with a pulley.

choices.label: Ask your regular customers to help

ok.text: Fourteen Kwik Mart regulars turn up. The piano is up in ten minutes. You owe everyone a discount.

effects.remember: Moved {friend}'s piano with fourteen Kwik Mart customers.

text.text: {rival} invited you to {rival.his} birthday party. Ever since the envelope, {rival.he} has been almost nice to you. Almost.
{rival} invited you to {rival.his} birthday party. After the interview stunt, you're not sure if it's a peace offer or a trap.
{rival} invited you to {rival.his} birthday party. You're not sure if it's a peace offer or a trap.

ok.text: {rival} opens your gift: a framed photo of {rival.him} beating you at sports day. {Rival.he} laughs for real. Truce.

fail.text: {rival} locks you in the escape room “by accident”. For six hours. Still, it's progress.

effects.remember: Went to {rival}'s birthday. {Rival.he} locked you in the escape room.

choices.label: Go, but stay calm and let {rival.him} win the games

ok.text: {rival} wins everything and is in a wonderful mood. {Rival.he} gives you the last slice of cake.

effects.remember: Let {rival} win at {rival.his} own party. Got cake.

fail.text: You lose on purpose for an hour. Then {rival} cheats at charades and you lose your temper. And the charades.

hothead.text: {rival} cheats at charades. You flip the snack table. The guacamole hits the birthday cake. Nobody forgets it.

ok.text: You stay home. {rival} posts 200 photos. You are in none of them, on purpose.

choices.label: Notice {rival} is nervous nobody will come, and bring everyone you know

ok.text: Forty people turn up. {rival} doesn't know what to say. {Rival.he} hugs you, quickly, and pretends it was an accident.

effects.remember: Filled {rival}'s birthday with people. {Rival.he} hugged you.

title: The Stag Weekend
text: {friend} is getting married and you're in charge of the stag weekend. The budget is 40 €. The expectations are Las Vegas.

choices.label: Go big: a weekend in Las Vegas (a pub called Las Vegas, in the next town)

ok.text: The pub is amazing. There's karaoke and a man called Elvis who is called Dave. {friend} cries happy tears.

effects.remember: Took {friend} to “Las Vegas” for {friend.his} stag weekend.

fail.text: “Las Vegas” closed last year. You spend the night in a bus shelter singing Elvis.

choices.label: Camping, with a fire and terrible stories

ok.text: You tell stories until 4 a.m. {friend} says it's the best night of {friend.his} life. It rains on the speech at the wedding; nobody cares.

effects.remember: Took {friend} camping for the stag. Best night ever.

ok.text: {friend} says “no worries”. There are worries. {Friend.he} picks a new best man.
